name: Testing
rationale: Requires each generated slice to name proof commands before implementation is accepted.

sources.label: architect-mcp verification rule
sources.note: Generated architecture plans are only useful when each slice has a concrete way to prove behavior.

sources.label: verification-before-completion source material
sources.note: Completion claims require fresh evidence from the relevant command, reproduction, or inspection result.

sources.label: eval-driven-dev source material
sources.note: Evaluation fixtures should test the application or MCP behavior end to end with explicit criteria and pass/fail reporting.

rules: Every core workflow needs at least one behavior-level test.
Service/use-case logic should be testable without the UI.
Verification commands must be named before implementation.
Do not claim completion without fresh verification evidence.
Final output must report checks that passed, failed, were skipped, or were not run.
Eval fixtures should cover vague novice prompts, generated-app drift, stack-pack conflicts, memory safety, and hosted/local policy.
artifacts: package scripts or documented verification commands
reviewQuestions: Which command proves each generated slice works?
What evidence proves the root cause or behavior claim?
Which eval fixture would catch this failure mode if it regresses?
